title: Hybrid UV/COP advanced oxidation process using ZnO as a catalyst for dye degradation
author: Mahdizadeh, Nasiri, et al.

steps.title: Prepare and characterize ZnO nanoparticles
steps.instruction: Synthesize ZnO nanoparticles using a thermal method, then characterize the resulting particles by scanning electron microscopy (SEM), X‑ray diffraction (XRD), and transmission electron microscopy (TEM).

substeps.instruction: Synthesize ZnO nanoparticles via thermal method.
Characterize the nanoparticles using SEM, XRD, and TEM.

steps.title: Design batch reactor
steps.instruction: Construct or configure a batch reactor suitable for the subsequent advanced oxidation experiments.

steps.title: Compare oxidation processes
steps.instruction: Perform and compare four separate treatments on the target dye: photolysis, sole ozonation, catalytic ozonation (using the ZnO catalyst), and photocatalysis (UV with ZnO).

substeps.instruction: Carry out catalytic ozonation experiment with ZnO.
Carry out photocatalytic experiment with UV and ZnO.

steps.title: Optimize operational parameters
steps.instruction: Evaluate and optimize the operational parameters that influence AR18 dye removal efficiency.

steps.title: Determine wastewater quality
steps.instruction: Measure the physicochemical quality parameters of wastewater from the Yazdbaf textile factory.

steps.title: Study AR18 degradation kinetics
steps.instruction: Investigate the degradation kinetics of AR18 dye using the hybrid UV/COP advanced oxidation process.

steps.title: Evaluate degradation under optimal conditions
steps.instruction: Under the previously determined optimal conditions, assess the degradation of AR18 dye in the textile wastewater.
